statements.t: “Given our strong year-to-date results and continued momentum in key end markets, we ar e strengthening our outlook for organic revenue growth to approximately 6.5%.

Furthermore, the strength of our overall business allows us to reaffirm our full-year Adjusted EBITDA margin outlook of approximately 27.0%, which includes continued operational improvement partially offset by incremental transaction costs.”

The Company has not reconciled its forward-looking Adjusted EBITDA margin outlook to the most directly comparable GAAP measure; see “Full-Year 2026 Outlook” for an explanation of why the reconciliation is not available without unreasonable effort.

The E&E Transaction is an important strategic acquisition intended to strengthen the Company’s TIC capabilities in electromagnetic compatibility, wireless testing, electrical safety, medical devices and other technologies.
The Company’s 2026 outlook is based on a number of assumptions that are subject to change and many of which are outside the control of the Company.

These forecasted items are not within the Company’s control, may vary greatly between periods and could significantly impact future financial results.
